_doc: team-3 產出標工與效率 数据集的事实清单：每一条都能被查询证伪。来源 client/team-3/產出標工與效率計算-規格.md
name: eff_ops

tables.name: std_time
tables.why: 標工庫：每个款号 前段/後段 各一个秒数（規格 §A：A:E 前段、F:T 後段，各有自己的款号栏）

tables.name: material_master
tables.why: 物料主檔：查得到=新款；查不到=舊款（0.85 只对舊款生效）

tables.name: production_row
tables.why: 產量明細：生产报数 / 工作中心描述 / 種類a / 時效，带 src_row 可定位

tables.name: timesheet
tables.why: 工時明細：按 人員分類 / KPI屬性 / 在職情況 判定是否计入考核（規格 §D）

tables.name: bango_detail
tables.why: 幫工工時：調出只计参与考核者（其他/非W轉W級）、調入全计（規格 §D2）

tables.name: adjustments
tables.why: 調整工時 / 申訴扣減 / 被申訴（手填，留痕）

tables.name: kpi_snapshot
tables.why: 手工表 / KPI 表当年算出的数 —— 对账的另一半，i/m/n 各一列

tables.name: rule_regimes
tables.why: 口径变更史（生产报数 vs PR、0.85 只对舊款）

invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(st.seconds * pr.qty_report / 3600.0 * CASE WHEN (left(upper(pr.part_no),2)='M3' OR left(upper(pr.part_no),3) IN ('T14','T15') OR left(upper(pr.part_no),4) IN ('H128','H129')) OR mm.part_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.85 END)::numeric,4) FROM production_row pr JOIN std_time st ON upper(st.part_no)=upper(pr.part_no) AND st.side='front' LEFT JOIN material_master mm ON upper(mm.part_no)=upper(pr.part_no) WHERE pr.month='202610' AND pr.factory='DG' AND pr.dept='金架九部' AND pr.kind_a='架' AND pr.timeliness<>'不計' AND pr.work_center_desc='SH分公司前工序'

invariants.why: 規格 T1：金架九部後段 3454.0311
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(st.seconds * pr.qty_report / 3600.0 * CASE WHEN (left(upper(pr.part_no),2)='M3' OR left(upper(pr.part_no),3) IN ('T14','T15') OR left(upper(pr.part_no),4) IN ('H128','H129')) OR mm.part_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.85 END)::numeric,4) FROM production_row pr JOIN std_time st ON upper(st.part_no)=upper(pr.part_no) AND st.side='back' LEFT JOIN material_master mm ON upper(mm.part_no)=upper(pr.part_no) WHERE pr.month='202610' AND pr.factory='DG' AND pr.dept='金架九部' AND pr.kind_a='架' AND pr.timeliness<>'不計' AND pr.work_center_desc IN ('SH分公司包裝','SH分公司包裝HY')

invariants.why: 規格 T1/T3：金架九部產出標工 5771.679（i）
invariants.sql:
WITH i AS (
  SELECT pr.factory, pr.dept,
         sum(st.seconds * pr.qty_report / 3600.0 *
             CASE WHEN (left(upper(pr.part_no),2)='M3' OR left(upper(pr.part_no),3) IN ('T14','T15')
                        OR left(upper(pr.part_no),4) IN ('H128','H129')) OR mm.part_no IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.85 END) AS i_hours
    FROM production_row pr
    LEFT JOIN std_time st ON upper(st.part_no) = upper(pr.part_no)
         AND ((st.side='front' AND pr.work_center_desc='SH分公司前工序')
           OR (st.side='back'  AND pr.work_center_desc IN ('SH分公司包裝','SH分公司包裝HY')))
    LEFT JOIN material_master mm ON upper(mm.part_no) = upper(pr.part_no)
   WHERE pr.month='202610' AND pr.kind_a='架' AND pr.timeliness <> '不計'
   GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT round(i_hours,4) FROM i WHERE factory='DG' AND dept='金架九部'

WITH base AS (SELECT dept, sum(hours) b FROM timesheet WHERE month='202610' AND dept='金架九部' AND NOT (person_class LIKE '%固定人员%' OR person_class LIKE '%办单%' OR kpi_attr IN ('做辦','浮動')) GROUP BY 1), adj AS (SELECT dept, sum(hours) h FROM adjustments WHERE dept='金架九部' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(coalesce(b,0)+coalesce(h,0),4) FROM base LEFT JOIN adj USING (dept)

invariants.why: 規格 T3：金架九部 實際效率 96.48% = i ÷ m
invariants.sql: WITH i AS (SELECT sum(st.seconds*pr.qty_report/3600.0*CASE WHEN (left(upper(pr.part_no),2)='M3' OR left(upper(pr.part_no),3) IN ('T14','T15') OR left(upper(pr.part_no),4) IN ('H128','H129')) OR mm.part_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.85 END) v FROM production_row pr LEFT JOIN std_time st ON upper(st.part_no)=upper(pr.part_no) AND ((st.side='front' AND pr.work_center_desc='SH分公司前工序') OR (st.side='back' AND pr.work_center_desc IN ('SH分公司包裝','SH分公司包裝HY'))) LEFT JOIN material_master mm ON upper(mm.part_no)=upper(pr.part_no) WHERE pr.month='202610' AND pr.dept='金架九部' AND pr.kind_a='架' AND pr.timeliness<>'不計'), m AS (SELECT sum(t.hours) v FROM timesheet t WHERE t.month='202610' AND t.dept='金架九部' AND NOT (t.person_class LIKE '%固定人员%' OR t.person_class LIKE '%办单%' OR t.kpi_attr IN ('做辦','浮動'))) SELECT round((SELECT v FROM i)/((SELECT v FROM m) - 27.9 - 160.0),4)

invariants.why: 規格：金架燒焊部 產出標工 8884.684
invariants.sql:
WITH i AS (
  SELECT pr.factory, pr.dept,
         sum(st.seconds * pr.qty_report / 3600.0 *
             CASE WHEN (left(upper(pr.part_no),2)='M3' OR left(upper(pr.part_no),3) IN ('T14','T15')
                        OR left(upper(pr.part_no),4) IN ('H128','H129')) OR mm.part_no IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.85 END) AS i_hours
    FROM production_row pr
    LEFT JOIN std_time st ON upper(st.part_no) = upper(pr.part_no)
         AND ((st.side='front' AND pr.work_center_desc='SH分公司前工序')
           OR (st.side='back'  AND pr.work_center_desc IN ('SH分公司包裝','SH分公司包裝HY')))
    LEFT JOIN material_master mm ON upper(mm.part_no) = upper(pr.part_no)
   WHERE pr.month='202610' AND pr.kind_a='架' AND pr.timeliness <> '不計'
   GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT round(i_hours,3) FROM i WHERE factory='DG' AND dept='金架燒焊部'

invariants.why: 規格 T3：金架燒焊部 實際效率 73.46%
invariants.sql:
WITH i AS (
  SELECT pr.factory, pr.dept,
         sum(st.seconds * pr.qty_report / 3600.0 *
             CASE WHEN (left(upper(pr.part_no),2)='M3' OR left(upper(pr.part_no),3) IN ('T14','T15')
                        OR left(upper(pr.part_no),4) IN ('H128','H129')) OR mm.part_no IS NOT NULL
                  THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.85 END) AS i_hours
    FROM production_row pr
    LEFT JOIN std_time st ON upper(st.part_no) = upper(pr.part_no)
         AND ((st.side='front' AND pr.work_center_desc='SH分公司前工序')
           OR (st.side='back'  AND pr.work_center_desc IN ('SH分公司包裝','SH分公司包裝HY')))
    LEFT JOIN material_master mm ON upper(mm.part_no) = upper(pr.part_no)
   WHERE pr.month='202610' AND pr.kind_a='架' AND pr.timeliness <> '不計'
   GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT round(i.i_hours / s.m_hours, 4) FROM i JOIN kpi_snapshot s ON s.factory=i.factory AND s.dept=i.dept WHERE i.factory='DG' AND i.dept='金架燒焊部'
